snippet.title: Otto's Galactic Groove!! – Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Travel a galaxy full of musical aliens in this retro-inspired rhythm-action game! Coming soon to the Playdate handheld console.

Otto's Galactic Groove!! is being developed by Pawprints and features original music from Rupert Cole and characters and art by Edie Woolf.

For updates, sign up to Pawprints' occasional newsletter: https://pawprintsgames.substack.com/

Or follow Pawprints on Mastodon or Threads:
https://mastodon.gamedev.place/@pawprints
https://www.threads.net/@pawprintsgames

Edited by Jonny Pert from Frinin & Bok Films https://instagram.com/frininandbok
